form.title: Farmer verification
form.subtitle: Takes about 5 minutes. Have your IC ready.
form.previousFilled: Your previous details are filled in below. Change what's needed, then continue.
form.loadError: Your previous details couldn't be loaded. You can still fill in this form.

sections.identityDocsDesc: Only QURBI admins see these. They are used to confirm you are a real farmer.

fields.name: Full name (as on IC)
fields.delivery: How will you deliver to buyers?
fields.deliveryHint: You can change this later in your profile.

tips.corners: All 4 corners of the card are in the photo
tips.readable: Name and IC number are sharp and readable
tips.noGlare: No glare, flash reflection or fingers covering it

docs.selfieHint: A clear, recent photo of your face. An admin compares it with your IC photo.

selfieTips.light: Face the camera in good light.
selfieTips.remove: Remove sunglasses, mask or anything covering your face.

docs.certificateHint: Not every farmer has one. You can continue without it.

missing.name: Enter your full name as shown on your IC.
missing.phone: Enter a phone number buyers and QURBI can reach.
missing.delivery: Choose how you will deliver to buyers.
missing.icFront: Upload a photo of the front of your IC.
missing.icBack: Upload a photo of the back of your IC.
missing.selfie: Take a selfie so we can match it to your IC.

hint.ready: All done. Next, read and sign the farmer policy.

policy.title: Policy & terms
policy.subtitle: Last step before we review your account.

identityStorage.title: IC, selfie and document storage
identityStorage.text: I consent to QURBI securely storing my IC, selfie and submitted documents for manual identity verification and account administration.

platformMarkup.title: 20% platform markup
platformMarkup.text: I understand QURBI may add a 20% markup on top of the price I set for livestock displayed to buyers.

accurateInformation.title: Accurate information
accurateInformation.text: I confirm my personal, farm, livestock and pricing information is truthful, complete and kept up to date.

animalCompliance.title: Animal health and legal compliance
animalCompliance.text: I am responsible for animal welfare and compliance with applicable Malaysian livestock, health, permit and movement requirements.

deliveryResponsibility.title: Delivery responsibility
deliveryResponsibility.text: I will fulfil orders according to my selected delivery method and cooperate with QURBI where platform delivery is selected.

privacyEnforcement.title: Privacy and platform enforcement
privacyEnforcement.text: I will protect buyer information and accept that QURBI may review, reject or suspend accounts that breach these terms.

policy.nextText: A QURBI admin checks your IC, selfie and farm details — usually within 1–2 working days. You'll be able to list livestock once approved.
policy.submitFailed: Submission failed. Your details are saved on this device; please try again.

pending.title: We're checking your application
pending.thanks: Thank you! There's nothing more you need to do right now.

sent.title: Application sent
sent.text: We received your details, IC and selfie.

review.title: Admin review
review.text: A QURBI admin checks your documents. Usually 1–2 working days.

start.title: Start selling
start.text: Once approved, you can list livestock and receive orders.

rejected.title: Your application needs a fix
rejected.intro: We couldn't approve it yet. Fix the item below and send it again — it only takes a few minutes.
rejected.noReason: No reason was given. Please contact QURBI support before resubmitting.

fixSteps.tap: Tap “Fix and resubmit”. Your previous details are filled in for you.
fixSteps.change: Change what the admin asked for — for example retake a blurry IC photo.
fixSteps.sign: Sign the policy again and submit. We'll review it again in 1–2 working days.
